question: What is the meaning of renewable materials percentage out of the total product mass in relation to renewable materials?
data_point: renewable materials percentage out of the total product mass
description: The renewable materials percentage out of the total product mass indicates the proportion of materials that can be recycled or reused, contributing to a more sustainable and circular economy. This metric is crucial in assessing the environmental impact and resource efficiency of a product or building. In the context of sustainable construction, it is a key indicator for evaluating the potential of a material or product to reduce waste and minimize environmental harm.
